import json,os

src='''def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    from collections import deque
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=8 and not seen[i][j]:
                comp=[];q=deque([(i,j)]);seen[i][j]=True
                while q:
                    r,c=q.popleft();comp.append((r,c))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]!=8 and not seen[nr][nc]:
                            seen[nr][nc]=True;q.append((nr,nc))
                cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r,c in comp if g[r][c]!=0]
                rs=[r for r,_,_ in cells];cs=[c for _,c,_ in cells]
                ar,ac=min(rs),min(cs);ph=max(rs)-ar+1;pw=max(cs)-ac+1
                P=[[0]*pw for _ in range(ph)]
                for r,c,v in cells:P[r-ar][c-ac]=v
                for r,c in comp:
                    out[r][c]=P[(r-ar)%ph][(c-ac)%pw]
    return out
'''

src3='''def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    from collections import deque
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=8 and not seen[i][j]:
                comp=[];q=deque([(i,j)]);seen[i][j]=True
                while q:
                    r,c=q.popleft();comp.append((r,c))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]!=8 and not seen[nr][nc]:
                            seen[nr][nc]=True;q.append((nr,nc))
                cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r,c in comp if g[r][c]!=0]
                rs=[r for r,_,_ in cells];cs=[c for _,c,_ in cells]
                ar,ac=min(rs),min(cs);ph=max(rs)-ar+1;pw=max(cs)-ac+1
                P=[[0]*pw for _ in range(ph)]
                for r,c,v in cells:P[r-ar][c-ac]=v
                RR=min(r for r,c in comp);RC=min(c for r,c in comp)
                for r,c in comp:
                    out[r][c]=P[(r-RR)%ph][(c-RC)%pw]
    return out
'''
